gloss: monthly tuition fee; monthly lesson fee

definitions.gloss: monthly tuition fee; monthly lesson fee
definitions.explanation: A fixed fee paid each month for lessons, classes, or instruction. Commonly used for private lessons, cram schools, martial arts dojos, and similar learning settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月謝|げっしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The monthly fee for piano lessons is ten thousand yen.

examples.japanese: {月謝|げっしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}い→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to pay the monthly tuition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習|なら}い{事|ごと}→習い事：13902_naraigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月謝|げっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The monthly fees for our children's lessons are straining the household budget.

notes:
USAGE:
{月謝|げっしゃ} specifically refers to fees paid monthly for ongoing instruction. It is not used for one-time payments or university tuition (⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧ or ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月謝|げっしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay the monthly fee)
- {月謝|げっしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧ (to submit the monthly fee — more formal)
- {月謝|げっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (the monthly fee is expensive)
- {月謝|げっしゃ}{袋|ぶくろ} (envelope for monthly fees)

FORMS:
{月|げつ} (month) + {謝|しゃ} (gratitude/remuneration). The {謝|しゃ} carries the sense of payment in appreciation for instruction.
